summaries.title: VisCo: Leveraging Large Language Models as Intrinsic Encoders for Visual Token Compression
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销、显存占用与端侧资源受限」痛点，作者围绕 **VisCo** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Model (VLM)）。核心论点主张：Motivated by this, we propose VisCo, a training-efficient self-compression framework that reuses the pretrained VLM itself as an intrinsic compressor。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制、动态记忆槽更新与检索增强机制。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：While training-free strategies rely on heuristic metrics and suffer significant performance degradation under high compression ratios, many...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Experiments show that VisCo surpasses prior methods across all evaluated compression ratios, with larger gains under more aggressive compression, and remains stable even in the extreme...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 1 赞），本工作为突破 **视觉-语言与长视频理解 (VLM & Video)** 中的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
